M3 Slice 3 — join grant, /table/{id} routing, sitting open + membership. Extract at repo root:

bash
cd /home/kushal/src/dotnet/myrestaurant
tar -xzf ~/Downloads/myrestaurant-m3-slice3.tar.gz
cat docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.append.md >> docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.md && rm docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.append.md
Files to delete: none
Everything is an in-place edit or a new file. The only file that shouldn't remain is docs/BUILD_PROGRESS.append.md, which the second command consumes.

What's in it
New — DataAccess

src/MyRestaurant.DataAccess/Sittings/SittingDirectory.cs — ISittingDirectory/DapperSittingDirectory. Every column table-qualified (the 42702 lesson — table_sitting, restaurant_table, and table_sitting_member all carry same-named id columns), internal row types with DateTime projected to DateTimeOffset.
src/MyRestaurant.DataAccess/Sittings/SittingMembership.cs — ISittingMembership/DapperSittingMembership. Per-table pg_advisory_xact_lock, re-reads the open sitting under it, so two guests scanning the same display in the same second land in the same sitting instead of racing table_sitting_one_open_per_table.
New — WebApplication

Tables/JoinGrant.cs — JoinGrant / JoinGrantProtector / JoinGrantCookie. Purpose MyRestaurant.Tables.JoinGrant.v1, cookie myrestaurant.join.
Identity/PersonPrincipal.cs — one place to read the person id off a principal.
Components/Pages/Table/TableJoin.razor — /table/{TableId:guid}, anonymous, static SSR, the whole §4.4 state machine.
Edited — TablesServiceCollectionExtensions.cs (3 registrations), TableArea.razor (/table becomes the sittings index), Program.cs (comment only — verified by diff), TablesWiringTests.cs (+3 facts, + IIdentifierFactory and an ephemeral DP provider in the test container).

New tests — SittingMembershipTests (Testcontainers, 9), JoinGrantTests (8), PersonPrincipalTests (6).

Two decisions worth flagging
A deactivated table doesn't evict an existing member. §4.1 says deactivating stops token validation and display rendering; it doesn't say it ends a sitting in progress. So the membership check runs before the active gate, and a member sees their table with a warning banner. New joins still get TableUnavailable.

Token validation is GET-only. The join form posts back to the same URL including ?token=, so re-validating there would double-count one scan in table_join_tokens_validated_total. The metric now means "a code was scanned."

I verified SupplyParameterFromQueryAttribute.Name, HttpMethods.IsGet, and — for the double-Set-Cookie concern on the join POST — that ResponseCookies.Delete strips prior matching appends before writing the deletion cookie, against dotnet/aspnetcore release/10.0.

Razor is where a compiler catch is most likely, and there are two new/changed components. Give me the dotnet build output if anything trips.
